comment: The test needs someone to rotate the OP's keys between its two JWKS fetches, which an unattended run cannot do. NetOidc rotates keys with notBefore/notAfter or an IKeyStore (docs/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md); this is self-attested for certification.
Deliberate (REMEDIATION_PLAN P2.4): the UserInfo endpoint accepts the access token only in the Authorization header; RFC 6750 section 2.2 form-body tokens are optional.
